cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Say You’re Sorry
cards.instruction: Maneuver someone into apologizing without naming the offense.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your parents arrive in ten minutes. This would be a good time to use the apology I taught you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I sent you a thumbs-up. I thought we'd sorted it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent thumb control. Now the part with actual remorse.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll send a sad face, then.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your face is right here. Put a sentence beginning with 'I' under it before the doorbell goes.
